newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Koreans on massive exodus to celebrate holiday.
newsitem.headline: S.Koreans on massive exodus to celebrate holiday.

text.p: An estimated 28 million South Koreans - nearly half the population - are expected to travel by road or rail during the traditional Chusok festival, a transport ministry official said.
The four-day holiday which started on Thursday is one of the nation's most important celebrations when families gather to pay respect to ancestors in the time-honoured Confucian tradition.
South Korea's television showed extensive footage of highways around the capital virtually turned into vast parking lots flooded with vehicles.
The official said it took about 12 hours to travel from Seoul to the second largest city of Pusan by car against a normal five hours.
